title: Page view count
description: User-visible views, derived from page_render by deduping repeated renders of the same object within a declared session. Never uses inferred identity.
numerator: distinct (session_ref, object_ref) among page_render/web with non-null session_ref, PLUS count of page_render/web with null session_ref
dedupe_rule: dedupe key = (session_ref, object_ref) when session_ref is non-null; renders with null session_ref are NOT deduped (each counts once). Fingerprinting to dedupe is prohibited (A3).
